friction: operating_points entries (ac|weights|structural_fudge, ac|propulsion|propeller|diameter, ac|propulsion|engine|rating) validated fine but were silently ignored at run time (recorded diameter stayed 2.28, engine 750 hp).

aircraft_data is silently ignored when aircraft_template is also given; with no template it is used whole, and a partial dict fails with confusing 'connect from input' errors that name no missing fields.
run_plan 'overrides' is deep-merged at the plan root, not into the model: giving variable names failed with 'Additional properties are not allowed'.
Workaround: plan-level initial_values (found only in the omd://plan-schema resource) did apply propeller diameter 2.2 m and engine rating 1117.2 hp.
initial_values silently ignores unknown or unsettable names (a deliberately bogus name ran without any warning).

Structural weight factor 2.0 could NOT be applied: template+aircraft_data, a full inline aircraft_data (which reproduced the template OEW exactly) with structural_fudge 2.0, initial_values on many candidate paths, shared_vars and propulsion_overrides all left it at 1.6 (W_structure_adjusted/W_structure = 1.6). validate_plan accepts 'ac|weights|structural_fudge' as a design variable, but the run fails with 'Output not found'. So all results use a lighter airframe than specified.

include_cost_model takes no parameters; I could not set or verify the paper's cost inputs (fuel $2.50/gal, $36/MWh on 90% of battery energy, $277/kg airframe, $775/shp engine, $100/shp motor and generator, 1.1 OEM premium, 5 flights/day for 15 years, battery $50/kg over 1500 cycles), so doc_per_nmi uses the server's defaults.
No plan_add_constraint builder tool, so constraints and optimizer settings had to be written as raw YAML via write_plan.
Inputs are not stored in results even at recording_level=full, so the structural factor value could not be read back directly.
get_results with summary=true returned more than 300k characters and was unreadable without filesystem access.
run_plan returns full per-node mission profiles on every call, which makes responses very large.

The second start point (MTOW 5200, battery 1200 kg, hybridization 0.9) reported status 'converged' after one recorded driver iteration with objective 0.4564980004186236; the validator flagged it as suspicious and I discarded it as a premature exit.
